cancelled: Execution cancelled. A new draw is required to start again.
noResultBody: This execution has no result to display.
generationInterruptedBody: The execution was created, but generation could not be completed.
noSolution: No valid resolution could be generated.
fallback: The draw state is available below.
title: Draw {{kind}}
confirmAbandon: The preview is discarded. Places in the phase are not changed.
confirmRedo: This cancels the execution, releases placements still aligned with it, then starts a new preview, as a single operation: if any step fails, nothing changes.
confirmRedoGroups: This cancels the execution, removes only the teams the draw placed, then starts a new preview. Teams placed by hand or qualified stay in place. If any step fails, nothing changes.
confirmRedoCup: This cancels the execution, releases only the slots the draw placed, then starts a new preview. Teams placed by hand or qualified stay in place. If any step fails, nothing changes.

redoBlocked.cupFixtureAttached: The draw cannot be redone: a match is attached to a confrontation this release would touch.
redoBlocked.groupMatchesAttached: The draw cannot be redone: matches are already attached to this phase.
redoBlocked.launchGridNotVacant: The draw cannot be redone while bracket places are occupied. Clear or release places, or cancel the applied draw before starting a full reshuffle.
redoBlocked.launchDirectAssignment: The draw cannot be redone while a direct assignment occupies a slot.
redoBlocked.reservedSeats: The draw cannot be redone: places are reserved by a qualification or a progression.
redoBlocked.fixedPotConflict: The draw cannot be redone: two teams from the same pot are in the same group.
redoBlocked.fixedOutsideComposition: The draw cannot be redone: a fixed team is no longer in the composition.
redoBlocked.fixedExceedsCapacity: The draw cannot be redone: a group holds more teams than places.
redoBlocked.groupShape: The draw cannot be redone: the group shape is not valid.
redoBlocked.missingPots: The draw cannot be redone: pots are not defined.
redoBlocked.noFreeSlot: The draw cannot be redone: there is no free slot. Teams already placed stay in place.
redoBlocked.notEnoughTeams: The draw cannot be redone: not enough unplaced teams to fill every free slot.
redoBlocked.tooManyTeams: The draw cannot be redone: too many unplaced teams for the free slots.
redoBlocked.lifecycle: The draw cannot be redone in the phase’s current state.

releaseHeldByActive: Abandon the active execution to release these placements
releaseBlockedAttachedMatches: Release is unavailable: matches are already attached to this phase.
releaseBlockedByPublishedDraw: Release is impossible: a published draw occupies the phase.
confirmApply: This updates places in the phase. No matches are created.
confirmCancelApplied: This action cancels the draw execution. It does not remove placements already applied to the stage. After cancelling, use “Release N/M” to clear places still aligned with this execution.
confirmCancelAppliedGroups: The draw will be cancelled. Teams stay where they are and are no longer protected. “Release” then removes only the teams the draw placed; teams placed before the draw stay. If you start a new draw without releasing, every team still in place is kept.
confirmCancelAppliedGroupsMatches: Matches have been generated: release will not be possible.
toastGenerationFailed: Generation interrupted. The execution was created without a result.
toastActionFailed: The action could not be completed.
confirmRelease: Places still populated according to this draw will be cleared. Direct assignments and other feeds will not be modified.
originManualHint: Display origin: manual or from a previous draw.
